page.overview:
What is Swadloon?

Swadloon is a mainly round Pokémon that resembles a pupating caterpillar wrapped in leaves. Its body is yellow, and it is wrapped in a cloak of green leaves. On the top of its head is a "V" shaped green leaf-like appendage. Its frowning expression gives it a gloomy, sorrowful, shy look.

On its back are the veins of the leaf as well as a bit at the bottom tip of the cloak resembling a rounded tail. Swadloon lives on the forest floor and converts fallen leaves into nourishment, which helps the surrounding plant life grow.

Swadloon evolves from Sewaddle starting at level 20 and evolves into Leavanny if leveled up with high friendship.

Swadloon is likely based on a inside a chrysalis. It may be based on a or , both of which cover themselves with leaves as shelter. Its appearance and usage on leaves like a blanket to hide itself could also be based on a , which is a shut-in or person suffering from a in Japanese culture.
